issues.description: The problem statement and UML require public getters for each attribute (tests reference getLectureName and getNumberOfInscribedStudents), but the solution implementation declares some getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch could confuse students and cause tests that expect public accessors to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter methods public in the implementation so they match the UML and the problem description. Specifically change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public so students and tests can access them as intended.
